sql_query:
SELECT s.artist,
       COUNT(*) AS scrobble_count,
       ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t
                                 IGNORE NULLS), ', ') AS matching_tags
FROM `netdev-firebase.barogroove_analytics.scrobbles` AS s,
     UNNEST(s.tags) AS t
WHERE LOWER(t) LIKE '%french chanson%'
  OR LOWER(t) LIKE '%chanson française%'
  OR LOWER(t) LIKE '%chanson francaise%'
  OR LOWER(t) = 'chanson'
  OR LOWER(t) LIKE '%trip-hop%'
  OR LOWER(t) LIKE '%trip hop%'
GROUP BY s.artist
ORDER BY scrobble_count DESC
LIMIT 6
